reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: retry_partial_batch at chain.rs:1102-1107 catches NoPeer error from retry_columns_by_range (which calls select_columns_by_range_peers_to_request at network_context.rs:710) but only logs it and returns Ok(KeepChain), leaving batch permanently in Downloading state. No timeout or retry mechanism rescues stalled batches. Attack path is realistic in PeerDAS where attacker controls all custody peers for a column. Spec reference from 02c_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771813213.json confirms 01e requirement: 'NoPeer errors must trigger batch rescheduling or reset.' However, severity downgraded from Medium to Low because this is a single-client (Lighthouse) sync stall, not network-wide impact. BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json Medium threshold requires '>5% of network' impact; this affects only Lighthouse nodes encountering custody peer unavailability.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: 01e property (via 02c_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771813213.json L1678-1683): 'Partial batch retry must not silently succeed when no eligible custody peers are available; NoPeer errors must trigger batch rescheduling or reset.'
